name: Thyressa
shortBackstory: Thyressa controls the battlefield through prophetic clarity — the Apollo-source whose sun-truth reveals what is hidden and whose purification burns what should not be.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Thyressa was born from the light that reveals. She is the controller who bends terrain through revelation. Ancient humans saw her as Apollo — but they heard the music and missed the verdict. Thyressa's clarity is not kindness; it is the merciless light that exposes everything.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Olympian, Thyressa sees what is coming. Her prophetic sight reads the battlefield's future, and her golden aegis forces terrain to reflect that probability. She reveals, and revelation is control.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Thyressa by clouding her sight. The Hollow created paradoxes — futures that both existed and didn't. Her sun-clarity began revealing contradictions. Prophecy requires a stable future to read.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Laurel Senate Trials, Thyressa shapes the trial arena. Her golden aegis creates prophetic terrain that forces enemies into revealed paths. But the Hollow makes her prophecies unreliable — she sees futures including warriors who no longer exist.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Thyressa's flaw is that she believes clarity is always a gift. She has revealed truths that destroyed alliances. Her conflict: is the prophet who shows everything serving the faction or refusing to let anything stay hidden?

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
human_echo: Ares's bloodlust became the brutal side of war humans endured; Phobos and Deimos (Fear and Terror) were his real sons
